The Maiden Tower#001.src: Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
The Maiden Tower#001.dst: ¡Ah! ¿¡Qué haces en mi pantano!? ¿No sabes que los ogros vivimos solos por algo?
The Maiden Tower#001.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#002.src: Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
The Maiden Tower#002.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Vienes de allende el mar, de una tierra llamada Win? Pues de winner no tienes nada, renacuajo.
The Maiden Tower#002.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#003.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky I'm in a... mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
The Maiden Tower#003.dst: Está bien. Date por afortunado, hoy estoy de... humor. Hablaré contigo en vez de moler tus huesos para mi pan.
The Maiden Tower#003.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#004.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave you alone.
The Maiden Tower#004.dst: Los ogros somos duros. Gente independiente y solitaria. Si no nos molestas ni te metes en nuestra vida, te dejamos en paz.
The Maiden Tower#004.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#005.src: That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
The Maiden Tower#005.dst: Eso, hasta que toca buscarse pareja. Entonces movemos cielo y tierra para estar juntos.
The Maiden Tower#005.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#006.src: And... well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a Maiden's voice from inside.
The Maiden Tower#006.dst: Y... bueno, cuando se juntan dos ogros, es sencillo. Pero... pasé junto a una torre alta y oí dentro la voz de una damisela.
The Maiden Tower#006.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#007.src: Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
The Maiden Tower#007.dst: ¡Los ogros no vivimos en torres de cuento, ni tenemos una voz tan dulce que haga brotar flores!
The Maiden Tower#007.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#008.src: I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
The Maiden Tower#008.dst: Llevo un tiempo pensando cómo abordar esto... Los años me caen encima, necesito encontrar a alguien, y ella es la elegida.
The Maiden Tower#008.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#009.src: If you can help me out, I'll be real grateful. I'm sure I've got something that you'd like in exchange.
The Maiden Tower#009.dst: Si puedes echarme una mano, te lo agradeceré de verdad. Seguro que tengo algo que te guste a cambio.
The Maiden Tower#009.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#010.src: Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
The Maiden Tower#010.dst: Sigue el sendero pedregoso hasta la torre. Allí nos vemos; prepárate para hacer de celestino de un ogro.
The Maiden Tower#010.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#011.src: Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#011.dst: Sigue las piedras del sendero hasta la torre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#012.src: This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
The Maiden Tower#012.dst: Es aquí. Ella está arriba del todo... Recuerda, no pararé hasta conocerla. Si has venido, esto va para largo.
The Maiden Tower#012.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#013.src: I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
The Maiden Tower#013.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#014.src: Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
The Maiden Tower#014.dst: Allá va... ¡Saludos, bella dama de la torre! ¡Soy Sherk! ¡Oí vuestra voz en el camino y debo conoceros en persona! ...suena bastante formal, ¿no?
The Maiden Tower#014.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#015.src: Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However ...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
The Maiden Tower#015.dst: ¡Ohoho! ¿Un admirador? ¡Qué acento tan rudo y encantador! Mas ...si queréis verme, mostradme vuestra devoción, ¿sí?
The Maiden Tower#015.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#016.src: Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
The Maiden Tower#016.dst: Mujer, no tienes ni idea de lo que pides cuando hablas de devoción.
The Maiden Tower#016.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#017.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to his grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
The Maiden Tower#017.dst: Mi padre tenía una urna preciosa. Se la llevó a la tumba, y echo mucho de menos a mi querido padre.
The Maiden Tower#017.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#018.src: Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
The Maiden Tower#018.dst: Recuperad la urna para mí, para tener un recuerdo suyo. Adentraos en las criptas de {p}, tras el banco... Y probad vuestra devoción, querido pretendiente~
The Maiden Tower#018.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#019.src: ...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
The Maiden Tower#019.dst: ...¡Volveré! ¡Tendrás tu urna, sin duda! ... ...y yo una buena patada en el culo. No me apetece una masacre por un cacharro de barro, persona de Win.
The Maiden Tower#019.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#020.src: I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us... wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
The Maiden Tower#020.dst: Si entro en {p}, me atacarán. Si me atacan, devuelvo el golpe. Nos perseguirán... no querría presentarme ante ella así. Consígueme tú esa urna, ¿vale?
The Maiden Tower#020.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#021.src: Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#021.dst: Encuentra la urna en las catacumbas de {p}, detrás del banco de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#022.src: And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
The Maiden Tower#022.dst: Por esto te pedí ayuda. Por muy bien que unte la sangre en una tostada, debo guardar mis modales para la señorita.
The Maiden Tower#022.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#023.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about getting snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
The Maiden Tower#023.dst: Ya te tengo preparada una compensación, así que no temas quedarte sin mérito. Muchas gracias por la ayuda.
The Maiden Tower#023.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#024.src: Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
The Maiden Tower#024.dst: Solo una última cosa. Dudo que espere que sea un ogro quien suba a su torre. No quiero que se asuste y salga huyendo.
The Maiden Tower#024.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#025.src: So, Win person. Care to temper her expectations before I arrive? Head up before me.
The Maiden Tower#025.dst: Así que, persona de Win. ¿Te importa rebajarle las expectativas antes de que llegue? Sube tú primero.
The Maiden Tower#025.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#026.src: Enter the tower and make Sherk confess his love to the maiden.
The Maiden Tower#026.dst: Entra en la torre y haz que Sherk le confiese su amor a la damisela.

The Maiden Tower#027.src: Ohoho... you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
The Maiden Tower#027.dst: Ohoho... eres uno de esos humanos sobre los que he leído, ¿verdad? ¿De verdad venías a ser mi pretendiente, querido?~
The Maiden Tower#027.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#028.src: Not exactly, milady! I'm the one seeking your affections- Coming up the ladder. I know I may not be a fairytale husband, but-
The Maiden Tower#028.dst: ¡No exactamente, mi señora! El que busca vuestro cariño soy yo; estoy subiendo por la escalera. Sé que quizá no sea un marido de cuento, pero-
The Maiden Tower#028.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#029.src: Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite too... Oh you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
The Maiden Tower#029.dst: ¡Ay...madre...mía! ¡¡Un ogro grande, fuerte y bien plantado!! ¡Que no es de cuento, dice! Y además tan educado... Ay, serás un marido perfecto, jiji~
The Maiden Tower#029.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#031.src: Aren't your type supposed to be less... Ehm... Clefted? Grizzled? Pale?
The Maiden Tower#031.dst: ¿Las tuyas no deberían ser menos... Ejem... Hendidas? ¿Canosas? ¿Pálidas?
The Maiden Tower#031.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#032.src: Oh, come here, Sherky-pie, give me a big kiss! And no need to worry, there's plenty more in store for my big hubby after that~
The Maiden Tower#032.dst: ¡Ay, ven aquí, Sherquito mío, dame un besazo! Y no te preocupes, que para mi maridote hay mucho más después de eso~
The Maiden Tower#032.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#033.src: Cor, lady! Even for an ogre you're layin' it on a bit thick! Aah, you see, ogres, and people like you, they have layers, right? And your first one is... Eh... ...rotten.
The Maiden Tower#033.dst: ¡Madre mía, señora! ¡Incluso para un ogro te estás pasando! Ay, mira, los ogros y la gente como tú tenemos capas, ¿no? Y tu primera capa es... Eh... ...podrida.
The Maiden Tower#033.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#034.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone who has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
The Maiden Tower#034.dst: Seguro que en algún sitio encuentras a un buen chaval que te quiera como eres, pero hasta que des con alguien sin criterio, ¡¡guarda esos labios espeluznantes donde no los vea!!
The Maiden Tower#034.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#035.src: ...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior ...but you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
The Maiden Tower#035.dst: ...Su-supongo que estaba podrido por dentro, pese a su...s-suculento exterior ...pero tú me consolarás, ¿verdad, humano t-tan macizo? ¡¿Verdad?! ¡¿VERDAD?!!
The Maiden Tower#035.speaker: Maiden
